verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a masanil heb' etisraelal to a heb' anima penaay yuj lepra, heb' tz'el yinhatil yuj junok ilya ayoch t'ay, ma heb' syaman junok chamnak, yowalil tz'ik'jiel heb' t'a spatikel campamento.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', tz'ik'jiel heb', heb' winh winak ma heb' ix ix, yik malaj tas manh wach'ok t'a yol campamento b'aj ayinek' heyet'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel yik'anelta juntzanh heb' anima chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak, ma junok ix ix max in k'anab'ajani, syixtan yetanimail, wan yoch smul.
Yowalil syojtakejel spaltail chi'. Hanhejtona', yowalil syak'xi sk'exul tastak ix yixtejb'at chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh stojol juntzanh chi'.

Tato toxo ix cham jun mach ix ixtajb'at tastak ay t'ay chi', manhxa pax junok ayto yuj sb'a smoj schaan sk'exul junok tas chi', a jun chi', tz'ochkan wikok, haxo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote skani. Hanhejtona' syak'anpax junok nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix och chi'.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' etisraelal t'ayin, tz'ik'jib'at t'a heb' sacerdote. Ha juntzanh chi', yik heb' sacerdote chi' yaji.
Masanil tastak syak' junok etisraelal t'ayin, tato tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sacerdote, yik winh tz'ajkani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés
to syal juntzanh tik winh t'a heb' yetisraelal: Talaj ay junok winak sna t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum to ay smul ix say t'a yol sk'ab',

to smulan ix yet' junok winak, palta max nachajel-laj yuj winh tato toxo ix mulan ix, yujto max yal ix, malaj pax junok mach ix ilan smulan ix. Mato ay pax junok winak tonhej snaank'e icha chi' t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum chi', wach'chom malaj smul ix syak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

Ha t'a cha makan lolonel icha chi', a winh winak chi', syal yik'anb'at ix yetb'eyum winh t'a yichanh junok winh sacerdote. Syak'an chanheok libra ixim harina cebada winh ofrendail yuj ix, palta max sekjiemlaj aceite t'a yib'anh ixim, max ak'jipaxlaj incienso yet' ixim, yujto a jun ofrenda chi', ofrenda yik k'ak'alk'olal, yopisio yik scheklajelta mul.
Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to snitzkot sb'a ix ix chi', tz'ik'jioch ix t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.

Elanhchamel syik'kot jab'ok ha ha' winh sacerdote chi' t'a yol junok lum uk'ab', haton ha ha' wiknhej yaji. Syik'anpaxk'e jab'ok pokok winh, haton lum ay t'a in kajnub', syak'anb'at winh t'a skal ha ha' chi'.

Tz'och linhan ix ix chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, syik'anel sk'ox ix, tz'ak'jipaxoch jun ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Haxo winh sacerdote chi' et'jinakk'e ha ha' k'a' tz'ik'ankot yaelal,

schekan winh yak' sti' ix. Syalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Tato yel maj ach mulan yet' junokxo winak t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum tik, malaj tas ol ach ik'anok a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' k'a' et'jinak yaelal tik.
Palta tato ix ach mulan yet' junokxo winh winak jun, ix och a mul t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum,
a Jehová ol ach ak'ankanoch ch'oxnab'ilok t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab'. Ol ach b'inaj yuj heb' t'a chukal, ol malk'e a k'ool, ol takjok yib' a xub'.
Haton wal jun yaelal chi' ol jawok t'a ib'anh a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' tik, yujto ha ha' et'jinak yaelal, xcham winh sacerdote chi' t'a ix. Haxo stak'wi ix ix chi': Ujokab' icha chi', xcham ix.
Ha juntzanh katab' chi', tz'ib'chajokab'kan yuj winh sacerdote. Slajwi chi' sb'ikanel winh yet' ha ha' k'a' tz'em t'a yol uk'ab' chi'.
Slajwi chi' syuk'anem ha' ix ix chi', haxo yik slajwi yuk'an ha' ix, skotkan yaelal t'a yib'anh ix.
Schaanek' ixim harina cebada ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal winh sacerdote chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ha jun ofrenda chi' sb'akhoch winh sacerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.
Syik'ank'e jun wotzok jun ofrenda winh sacerdote chi', snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yuj sch'oxankot masanil jun ofrenda chi'. Ayik toxo ix yuk'ej ha ha' k'a' chi' ix,

tato ay smul ix t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum chi', skot yaelal t'a yib'anh ix yuj ha ha' syuk'em chi'. Smalk'e sk'ool ix, stakji yib' xub' ix, tz'ochkan ix ch'oxnab'ilok yet' sb'inaj t'a chukal t'a skal chonhab' chi'.
Palta tato yel malaj jab'ok smul ix, malaj jab'ok tas tz'ik'an ix, yuj chi' scheklajeli to malaj smul ix, syalnhej yalji yune' ix.
Haton jun ley tik tz'och t'a yib'anh ix ix smulan t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum, yuj chi' tz'och winh yetb'eyum ix chi' t'a k'ak'alk'olal.

Tato ay junok winak tonhej tzek' t'a yib'anh yak'an k'ak'alk'olal t'a ix yetb'eyum, a jun winak chi' yowalil syik'kot ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yik sb'oan winh sacerdote chi' masanil tas syal jun ley tik.
Tato yel ay smul ix ix chi', ha t'a yib'anh ix skan smul chi'. Haxo t'a yib'anh winh winak chi' malaj tas skani, xchi Jehová.
